remarks: A Broad River 3BR, 2BTH beauty for you to view! This cape cod home has a terrific layout with a BR/BTH on the main level and 2BRS/BTH on the upper level. Primary BR/BTH can be on either floor. The DR can accommodate a large formal table. The gorgeous renovated eat-in-kitchen, equipped with ss appliances, is the centerpiece with a separate breakfast nook and access to a private deck & multi-tiered backyard. The sun-filled 2nd floor along with the 2BRS, includes an open study/den loft area w/skylight plus BTH w/skylight. Enjoy the 'peaceful easy feeling' off your BR balcony with access to the main level deck! Besides the kitchen, within the last 3 years, the present owners have made the following key improvements: new hot air heating system, hw heater, carpet, and a fresh coat of paint! Convenient to all shopping, restaurants, Merritt Parkway, I-95 and RR. A full unfinished walkout basement comes in handy for the extra space/workshop! Mature landscaping, compliments the low maintenance yard! Just move in and don't forget to add the grill and outdoor furniture and you'll be all set!
